instruction: I want to change the font of all uppercase text in my document to Arial for better consistency with our branding guidelines. Please assist me.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Changes uppercase text font to Arial. Verified by checking all uppercase text runs use Arial font.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter uses text.isupper() which incorrectly identifies non-alphabetic text (numbers, punctuation, whitespace) as 'uppercase'
Example: '123'.isupper() returns True, but '123' is not uppercase text semantically
Example: '   '.isupper() returns True for whitespace-only text
The instruction asks to change 'all uppercase text' which semantically means intentionally capitalized letters (e.g., 'HELLO'), not numbers or punctuation
The getter should verify text contains alphabetic characters before checking isupper()
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: In docx_font_info__45c08963.py line 36, change condition from 'if text and text.isupper() and len(text.strip()) > 0:' to 'if text and text.strip() and any(c.isalpha() for c in text) and text.isupper():'
This ensures only text containing actual letters is checked for uppercase status
